label: H.R. 9330
title: Earned Wage Access Consumer Protection Act

items.snippet: Earned wage access products provide consumers with access to their earned wages before their scheduled pay day.
Under the bill, providers of earned wage access products must provide an alternative no-cost option for receiving earned wages if the provider offers an option to receive earned wages for a fee;
